where-the-bound-comes-from.text: As a folder, I need the bound read from the chain state the command acquired, because that is the state the node judges against.
The view already carries its tip: viewPoint is the chain point it was acquired at, and cpSlot is that point's slot (offchain/node-internal/Singular/Registry/Provider.hs). No interface changes.

builders-to-audit.text: The starting points found at intake. The commit owner confirms each, adds any missed, and writes the verdicts in the builder audit page, builder-audit.md.

slice.text: One slice, one commit owner, one commit per task in tasks. The release-PR investigation and the CI realism check report their verdicts before any code for them is written; a verdict that needs more than this ticket becomes its own bug.

live-boundary.text: No preprod writes and no new registry. The fix is proved on the development network and by the unit test; the stale preprod request is rejected by the operator after merge.
